name: Winter Survivor (Magic)
body:
You narrowly escaped death in the cold.

Prerequisite(s): Membership in an organization.

Benefit(s): You gain cold resistance 5 against the first cold damage you take each day, and gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against the fear effects of creatures with the cold subtype.
